scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Molokai library outreach arrival reliable while retaining the ticketed MKK flight and ordinary county-bus plan.
Emerging Need: Roadwork alone leaves the trip plausible, but a shortened room-access window and added wet trays turn the bus delay into a future lateness risk.
Decision Context: The useful timing depends on stored MKK transfer notes identifying the no-charge taxi backup hold, its dispatch channel, and its day-before cutoff.
Consequence: Once the backup board closes, the trip may still run, but day-of curb rides may not protect the setup window or tray handling.

parameter.body: County roadwork notice: on Wednesday, May 20, Kamehameha V Highway near the Kaunakakai approach will use single-lane convoy control from 09:00 to 11:00. Airport-to-town buses may see 25-40 minute delays. No extra luggage racks will be added.

parameter.content: Quick update for Wednesday: the children's room is only free from 10:05 to 10:20 for arranging the portable wet trays before the school group lines up at 10:25. The trays cannot be staged at the circulation desk.

parameter.subject: MKK Wednesday backup vehicle board closed
parameter.body: Dispatch bulletin: backup holds for Wednesday MKK airport pickups closed at 12:00 today. Day-of curb calls will be handled only as vehicles return, and trunk space cannot be guaranteed without a preassigned vehicle.
